cleanupEvidence: Project deletion outcomes are tracked in the Issue evidence comments.

method.shapeOrder: Odd pairs: 4k then 29k; even pairs reverse. In each shape: clean sync, conflict sync, source-only resolve.
method.fixture: Plain directories; 4000/29000 deep .ts paths, shared 33-byte initial body, one changed file per branch. Exact clean Candidate target, with the normal current-main read still present. Host bootstrap uses existing object recipes for the large State.
method.sourceIdentity: SHA-256 of unchanged flat State bytes
method.instrumentation: Installed CLI with credential-safe fetch observer; --detail receipts; numeric provider completion usage and existing forge-source-step counters. No URLs, auth, source bodies, account identifiers or machine paths retained. Repeated function names and field labels use the names/columns dictionaries; tuple rows retain every observed value.
qualifications: Baseline observations only; no candidate runtime deployed or timed. No Git, zoo, smoke or benchmark rerun.
Ten pairs is below the eleven-pair reference. Resampling intervals do not model machine load, swapping, network or runtime drift. No timed sample silently dropped or replaced.
First 4k clean sample lacks client phase detail; retains its original total/RPC trace and supplemental immutable server timing.

Provider figures are project-attributed completion usage within each command window, which can include project background overlap work. They are billed-usage metadata, not an invoice. Missing fields remain counted. Function execution walls are inclusive and can nest.

Source-step read/write/call clocks overlap, include consumer work, and omit some durable cursor I/O. They cannot yield exact pure compute or physical R2 GET bytes. Logical read-work bytes and attempted PUT body bytes are labeled separately.

Selected CLI builds may change automatically. Each detail receipt records its actual cliCommit; the first compact receipt has an unknown before pin and a known after pin. No hold was introduced for other builders.

notes: An initial nested clone bound its address to an ancestor Lane; standalone temporary fixture placement fixed setup.
One private-driver typo and malformed wait parameters failed before any timed sample.
Immediate save waits sometimes returned HOSTED_ACTION_FAILED although their original saves completed. Setup uses one read-only progress subscription and then the original CLI wait.
The first conflict result had a human workIn sentence; the driver was corrected to use its explicit root before resolve. No extra sync was run.

samples.note: Original compact receipt omitted client phase details. Source timing recovered by one read outside the timed sample; replay apply timing is not substituted.
